devices.name: Ethernet-capable source device
devices.description: Either a Wi-Fi router, a network gateway, or a Jio set-top box / media receiver with an RJ45 Ethernet socket; all are equally acceptable for this inspection. The installation being inspected uses a dark navy Jio set-top box with rounded corners, a circular Jio logo and one visible RJ45 Ethernet socket; its other connectors include HDMI, USB, coaxial-style and power connections. Do not require four yellow LAN sockets, LAN 1-4 labels or other router-specific features. In identification_basis, state which category it appears to be; never call a set-top box a router.

devices.name: PlayStation 5
devices.description: Original Sony PlayStation 5 console, disc edition (standard model, not Slim or Pro), standing upright: tall console with white outer covers around a black centre body. Its rear connection strip has two USB Type-A ports, one RJ45 Ethernet (LAN) port, one HDMI OUT port and an AC IN power connector.

devices.name: Television
devices.description: Any large flat-panel television or display, any brand, possibly wall-mounted. No logo, brand name or model text needs to be visible: a flat screen body, or the back or side panel of such a display, is enough to identify it. Its connection panel, which may be a recessed vertical panel at the rear or side, has several HDMI inputs and USB ports; HDMI numbers may be missing, hidden or unreadable. Identify ports by connector geometry and layout when printed labels are unavailable.

requirements.text: Connect the PlayStation 5 Ethernet LAN socket to an RJ45 Ethernet socket on an accepted source device (Wi-Fi router, network gateway, Jio set-top box or Ethernet-capable media receiver). Physical connector insertion and cable identity are verified; network or internet connectivity is not assessed.
Connect the PlayStation 5 HDMI OUT port to any HDMI input on the television with an HDMI cable seated at both ends.
